A U.S. passport fee depends on the document type and whether this is a first-time in-person application or a renewal [d1][d7]. The official State Department application fees shown here are $130 for a passport book, $30 for a passport card, and $160 for a passport book and card; expedited service is $60 and 1–2 day delivery for a new passport book is $21.36 [d1].

For first-time in-person applications, USPS says there is also a separate $35 acceptance fee paid at the Post Office or other acceptance facility [d5][d7]. That makes common first-time totals for adults $165 for a book, $65 for a card, and $195 for a book-and-card bundle; for children under 16, one source gives $135 for a book, $50 for a card, and $150 for the bundle [d8][d2].

If you mean a renewal by mail or online, the snippet from the State Department fee page shows the application amounts only, such as $130 for a book or $30 for a card, without the separate in-person acceptance fee [d1]. [[END-OF-ANSWER]]
